items.text: Steelers downgraded Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday vs NE; was Q on ETR list after LP-DNP-DNP.
items.why: Foot injury; practice progression LP-DNP-DNP then official downgrade.
items.implication: PIT WR volume to Metcalf/others; Germie Bernard interest per Levitan.
items.opportunity: Zero snaps for Pittman; elevated share for remaining PIT receivers.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is the biggest injury on the slate per Levitan; Q after limited Friday practice (missed first two); affects Herbert and many projections; 4pm ET game.
items.why: Rib injury exit Week 1; DNP Wed/Thu, limited Fri; Schefter confirms Q.
items.implication: GTD; if OUT, Johnston/others rise; Herbert projections down regardless of limited role risk.
items.opportunity: Reduced routes/contested catches possible if active; volume shift to QJ if out.

items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT (hamstring) on ETR Sunday injury report; confirmed ruled out by Schefter/Rapoport after midweek practice tweak, not believed serious but misses vs CIN.
items.why: Hamstring suffered Wednesday practice; DNP Thu/Fri; history of hamstring IR.
items.implication: HOU WR room thinned (already lost Higgins); volume to Schultz/Hutchinson/Boutte/Coker-type options; Stroud ceiling down.
items.opportunity: Zero routes/targets for Collins; elevated target share for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Zay Flowers (and Ja'Kobi Lane) OUT/DOUBTFUL on ETR list; Rapoport/Schefter confirm Flowers doubtful (hamstring) vs NO after limited Friday return following two DNPs.
items.why: Hamstring exit Week 1; missed Wed/Thu practice, limited Fri but not much work.
items.implication: Plan without; BAL WRs down to crumbs (Bateman WR1, Walker/Wester/Sarratt/Moore).
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Bateman/Andrews hierarchy if OUT.

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT/DOUBTFUL on ETR; Rapoport notes practiced Friday but doubtful (knee/meniscus) vs LAC; pregame test planned.
items.why: Meniscus trim pre-Week 1; limited Friday return after DNPs.
items.implication: Prepare without; Michael Mayer saw 7 targets in absence; late kick complicates.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go (back) per Rapoport headlines despite Q designation; said he's playing; ETR notes same.
items.why: Back injury but player confirmed playing; official Q but positive reports.
items.implication: Start Burrow confidently vs HOU; CIN offense intact.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected; no change to Chase/Higgins roles.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) missed Friday practice; added to injury report; Donald plans to debut MNF vs NYG. Monitor for Monday.
items.why: Hip issue; DNP Friday after full Thursday; prior psoas history.
items.implication: MNF uncertainty; have pivot ready; Adams/Whittington volume if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If out/limited, elevated snaps/targets for Adams and other LAR WRs.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR); Levitan eyes 10+ touches potential vs Stevenson despite unclear split; nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Full practice, 'ready to go'; ankle cleared; AJ Brown on IR.
items.implication: Henderson flex upside/handcuff; Stevenson snap share likely drops from 86%.
items.opportunity: Potential 10+ touches/routes expansion for Henderson; third-down/explosive role.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN on ETR Sunday injuries; expected back squeezes Etienne/Miller committee.
items.implication: Etienne downgrade (Berry hate); three-headed backfield risk.
items.opportunity: Kamara likely third-down/pass work; Etienne early-down split reduced.

items.text: Berry LOVES Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ target share (tied team lead), 74% snaps/21 of 24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1; IND gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 receiving usage (40% routes targeted) + smash matchup.
items.implication: RB1 upside; start with confidence as high-end RB2/1.
items.opportunity: 24% target share + high snap/touch rate; pass-game involvement sustained.

items.text: Berry LOVES Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (2nd only to Bijan); 19% target share last 10 games; Kubiak offense.
items.why: Near-max utilization + sustained target share; overreaction to injury scare.
items.opportunity: 99 util score, high touches + 19% tgt share.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% target share (career high), all RB RZ touches, 8 more routes than Gainwell; CLE soft vs run.
items.implication: RB2/flex with upside; clear lead over Gainwell.

items.text: Berry LOVES Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career with Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
items.why: Volume with Wentz starter + historical production + matchup.
items.implication: Elite WR1 start; volume floor high.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rush attempts Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara return further squeezes; underdog script.
items.why: Committee squeeze with Kamara IN + poor Week 1 efficiency split + tough matchup/script.
items.implication: Sit/fade; low-end flex at best in PPR.
items.opportunity: Reduced early-down and pass work expected.
